label: Diagnostic contact sheet derived exclusively from 120 previously captured B3 AFTER PNGs; not a new rendering capture.

transformation.ordering: 120 manifest frames in increasing index order, row-major, 12 columns by 10 rows
transformation.crop: 128 by 128 integer source pixels; x = Math.round(saved sunProjection[0] - 64), y = Math.round(saved sunProjection[1] - 64); all crops fully inside their original PNG; no padding or clamping.
transformation.scale: 1:1; each source pixel maps to one destination pixel; no resampling
transformation.pixelProcessing: No brightness, contrast, color, gamma, or other image adjustment; createImageBitmap colorSpaceConversion:none and premultiplyAlpha:none; sRGB Canvas2D; PNG output.
transformation.annotations: Title and DIAGNOSTIC description above the grid; frame numbers beneath each crop; no text or borders over source pixels.
transformation.verification: Every source SHA-256 matched both sequence.json and result.json; every composed tile matched its independently copied decoded source crop byte-for-byte in Canvas2D RGBA; raw source files were only read.

processing.method: Headless Chrome Canvas2D composition of file bytes; isolated about:blank document; no Cesium app, WebGPU scene, new capture, or test suite loaded.
